name: Savezone I&C Corporation
summary: Savezone I&C Corporation engages in the operation of fashion discount stores in South Korea. The company also operates convenience facilities, such as laundry, pharmacy, food court, art gallery, as well as Tap Play Coffee, a specialty coffee shop and Happy Day Festival, a café. In addition, it is involved in the operation of Save Zone Flower, which offers gifts, flowers, and potted plants; gift certificate dispensers; repair shop; specialty restaurant district; and Save Zone Sports Center, a fitness center. The company was formerly known as Uless Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Savezone I&C Corporation in 2004. Savezone I&C Corporation was founded in 2002 and is headquartered in Seoul, South Korea.
